valor: Pelu, de treinta y tantos, es el humilde proyeccionista de un cineclub municipal. Ante la crisis, debe convertirse en el vigilante nocturno del cine y, con el tiempo, el lugar se transforma en su nuevo hogar. Poco a poco, una pequeña comunidad empieza a formarse allí después del cierre: un grupo de cuidacarros que duermen en el cine y se vuelven sus amigos más cercanos, junto con Vale, una excompañera de colegio que usa el espacio para grabar videos para OnlyFans.

valor: Pelu, in his thirties, is the modest projectionist of a municipal film club. Faced with the crisis, he must become the cinema’s night watchman and over time, it turns into his new home. Little by little, a small community begins to take shape inside the cinema after closing hours. It consists of a group of “naranjitas” (informal parking attendants) who sleep there and, eventually, become his closest friends, along with Vale, a former classmate who uses the space to record OnlyFans videos.
